function common_dom_row_set_show_required_reset(dom_name, isShow, isRequired,
		isReset) {

	var rowDoms = priv_get_rowDom_by_control(null, dom_name);
	common_set_is_show_dom_row(null, dom_name, rowDoms, isShow);
	for (var i = 0; i < rowDoms.length; i++) {
		common_set_dom_clilds_required_reset(rowDoms[i], isRequired, isReset);
	}
}

function common_set_is_show_dom_row(dom_id, dom_name, rowDoms, isShow) {

		if (typeof (isShow) == "boolean") {
			isShow = isShow == true ? "" : "none";
		}
		if (typeof (rowDoms) == "undefined" || rowDoms == null)
			rowDoms = priv_get_rowDom_by_control(dom_id, dom_name);
		for (var i = 0; i < rowDoms.length; i++) {
			rowDoms[i].style.display = isShow;
		}

}

function priv_get_rowDom_by_control(dom_id, dom_name) {
	var rowDoms = [];
	// 根据ID隐藏
	if (dom_id != null) {
		var dom = typeof (dom_id) == "string" ? document.getElementById(dom_id)
				: dom_id;
		if (typeof (dom) == "undefined") {
			dom = typeof (dom_id) == "string" ? GetXFormFieldById(dom_id + ")")
					: dom_id;
		}
		while (typeof (dom) != "undefined") {
			dom = dom.parentNode;
			if (typeof (dom) != "undefined" && dom.tagName == "TR") {
				rowDoms.push(dom);
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	// 根据name隐藏
	if (dom_name != null) {
		var doms = typeof (dom_name) == "string" ? document
				.getElementsByName(dom_name) : dom_name;
		if (typeof (doms) != "undefined") {
			for (var i = 0; i < doms.length; i++) {
				var dom = doms[i];
				while (typeof (dom) != "undefined") {
					dom = dom.parentNode;
					if (typeof (dom) != "undefined" && dom.tagName == "TR") {
						rowDoms.push(dom);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return rowDoms;
}
